Hi Jacob —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we all have the same context: 

- Current focus: reducing latency and unit cost on customer-facing chatbots while maintaining hallucination controls and data privacy.
- Primary workloads: multi-turn product support chat, structured routing to KBs, and embeddings for semantic search.
- Constraints: cloud-only for now, but strong infosec requirements (audit logs, KMS).
- Success metric: reduce per-token cost by 30% and 99th percentile latency below 300ms for short responses.

Next steps we discussed:
1) Executive alignment call (VP Product + CTO) to review roadmap fit and procurement timeline.
2) Technical deep dive/demo with our Solutions Engineer to validate latency/cost profiles and discuss deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated).
3) Share a mutual action plan and initial SOW draft for budget review. (attached: redwood-product-one-pager.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx)

To make scheduling easier — would Jacob + Priya be available for a 30-min exec intro next week? Two slots that could work on our side:
- Tue Mar 16, 2027 — 11:00–11:30 AM PT
- Wed Mar 17, 2027 — 9:00–9:30 AM PT

If those don't work, send a preferred window or grab time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa_redwood/30min

I'll cc Markus to join the technical deep dive; he can lead the demo and bring benchmarks specific to multi-turn workloads.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.
